title: 1 million people flood Madrid streets to see the pope's flower-carpeted procession
script: Here is a fast update on a developing story. The main headline is this: 1 million people flood Madrid streets to see the pope's flower-carpeted procession. In simple words, The crowd cheered and shouted "This is the youth of the pope!" as Pope Leo arrived for Mass at a central Madrid plaza. It's the first papal visit to Spain in 15 years Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. We will continue watching for clearer and more reliable updates.
